name: M3_PPS205MI_LstMonitors
description: List purchase monitoring records for one or more purchase orders and display the full monitoring setup and status for each record. Each result includes identifiers (purchase order number, purchase order line, purchase order line subnumber, monitoring date), logistics context (facility, warehouse, supplier), and monitoring parameters such as monitoring activity list, status, date code, monitoring lead time, and whether the monitoring activity is active or already performed. Remarks, responsible user and text identity are also returned so external tools can present comments and related text together with the monitoring information.

inputParameters.name: PUNO
inputParameters.description: Purchase order number used to limit the list to monitoring records for a specific purchase order.

inputParameters.name: PNLI
inputParameters.description: Purchase order line number used to limit the list to monitoring records for a specific purchase order line.

inputParameters.name: PNLS
inputParameters.description: Purchase order line subnumber used to limit the list to monitoring records for a specific purchase order subline.

inputParameters.name: FUDX
inputParameters.description: Monitoring date used to limit the list to a specific scheduled monitoring activity date.

inputParameters.name: NFTR
inputParameters.description: Number of leading key fields to treat as filters so only records matching the entered key values are listed.

outputParameters.name: PUNO
outputParameters.description: Purchase order number for the monitoring record.

outputParameters.name: PNLI
outputParameters.description: Purchase order line number for the monitoring record.

outputParameters.name: PNLS
outputParameters.description: Purchase order line subnumber for the monitoring record.

outputParameters.name: FUDX
outputParameters.description: Monitoring date for which the purchase monitoring activity is scheduled.

outputParameters.name: FACI
outputParameters.description: Facility responsible for the monitored purchase order.

outputParameters.name: WHLO
outputParameters.description: Warehouse where the monitored purchase order is handled.

outputParameters.name: SUNO
outputParameters.description: Supplier number for the monitored purchase order.

outputParameters.name: FUSC
outputParameters.description: Code identifying the predefined list of monitoring activities for this purchase order.

outputParameters.name: STAT
outputParameters.description: Status of the monitoring record, for example preliminary, definite, or blocked.

outputParameters.name: DTCD
outputParameters.description: Code specifying which base date is used when calculating the monitoring date.

outputParameters.name: EALI
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the monitoring activity is currently active for this record.

outputParameters.name: FDAY
outputParameters.description: Number of days before or after the base date used to calculate the monitoring date.

outputParameters.name: REMK
outputParameters.description: Free-text remark or comment for the monitoring record.

outputParameters.name: RESP
outputParameters.description: User ID of the person responsible for this purchase monitoring activity.

outputParameters.name: FUPF
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the monitoring activity has already been performed.

outputParameters.name: TXID
outputParameters.description: Identifier of the detailed text or comments associated with the monitoring record.
